scenes.title: A simple practice routine
scenes.text: Welcome. This fictional practice routine shows how to prepare a tidy training workspace.

scenes.title: 01 / Clear your space
scenes.text: First, clear unnecessary items from your desk. Keep only the materials needed for this exercise.

scenes.title: 02 / Check your materials
scenes.text: Next, check that your practice document is open and your notes are ready.

scenes.title: 03 / Review before starting
scenes.text: Finally, review the exercise instructions. If anything is unclear, ask your trainer before continuing.

scenes.title: Ready to begin
scenes.text: You are ready to begin. Remember: clear, check, and review. This concludes our sample routine.
